description:
**`policies::lint_catalog(catalog: &LintCatalog) -> impl VerificationPolicy`** — wraps `pkix-lint::LintRunner` as a `VerificationPolicy`.

Each lint finding from the runner becomes a `Finding` with:
- `source = FindingSource::Lint(lint_id)`
- `severity` mapped from lint severity (Error → Error, Warn → Warn, Notice → Notice)
- `message` from lint finding detail
- `evidence` includes the cert index + the lint rule's stable ID

Per `.6` decision (lint integration model), this child exists only if option A (adapter) is chosen. If option B (parallel pipeline), this child closes as WONTFIX and `pkix-lint` stays standalone.

**Blocks on:** .1 (trait), .6 (lint integration model).
title: Implement policies::lint_catalog adapter
